generate_images_consistency_model: load a consistency model pipeline and generate images with one-step or multi-step sampling
generate_class_conditional_images: generate class-conditional images using the consistency model pipeline with a specific class label
prepare_latents: prepare random noise latents scaled by the scheduler init noise sigma for image generation
postprocess_image: postprocess a tensor sample by denormalizing and converting to PIL, numpy, or PyTorch format
prepare_class_labels: prepare class labels as a tensor for class-conditional consistency model inference
